name: Bleu de Chanel
description: An aromatic-woody fragrance that unites the invigorating freshness of citrus with the woody whisper of dry cedar. New Caledonian sandalwood lends it a warm and sensual trail.
description_en: An aromatic-woody fragrance that unites the invigorating freshness of citrus with the woody whisper of dry cedar. New Caledonian sandalwood lends it a warm and sensual trail.
description_tr: Sitrus notalarının canlandırıcı ferahlığını, kuru sedirin odunsu esintisiyle buluşturan aromatik ve odunsu bir koku. Yeni Kaledonya sandal ağacı, geride sıcak ve duyusal bir iz bırakıyor.

reviews.comment: An absolute masterpiece of modern blue fragrances. The ginger and incense make it incredibly versatile and sophisticated.
Very safe, universally loved. The grapefruit opening is sharp and clean, but the dry down is where the warmth truly shines.

name: Baccarat Rouge 540
description: Luminous and sophisticated, Baccarat Rouge 540 lays on the skin like an amber, floral, and woody breeze. A poetic alchemy where the aerial notes of jasmine and the radiance of saffron carry mineral facets of ambergris.
description_en: Luminous and sophisticated, Baccarat Rouge 540 lays on the skin like an amber, floral, and woody breeze. A poetic alchemy where the aerial notes of jasmine and the radiance of saffron carry mineral facets of ambergris.
description_tr: Işıltılı ve sofistike Baccarat Rouge 540, tene adeta amber, çiçeksi ve odunsu bir esinti gibi fısıldıyor. Yaseminin uçucu notaları ile safranın parlaklığının, gri kehribarın mineral yönlerini taşıdığı şiirsel bir simya.

reviews.comment: It smells like burnt sugar and luxury. It has an incredible sillage that lingers in the air long after you have left.
Incredibly airy yet present. Sometimes I get anosmic to it, but everyone around me comments on how heavenly it smells.

name: Aventus
description: The exceptional Aventus was inspired by the dramatic life of a historic emperor, celebrating strength, power, and success. Introduced in 2010, this scent has grown to become the most successful fragrance in the history of the brand.
description_en: The exceptional Aventus was inspired by the dramatic life of a historic emperor, celebrating strength, power, and success. Introduced in 2010, this scent has grown to become the most successful fragrance in the history of the brand.
description_tr: Sıra dışı Aventus, gücü, iktidarı ve başarıyı kutlayan tarihi bir imparatorun dramatik yaşamından ilham alıyor. 2010 yılında sunulan bu koku, markanın tarihindeki en başarılı parfüm haline gelmiştir.

reviews.comment: The pineapple opening combined with the smoky birch dry down is legendary. Still the king of masculine fragrances.
Batch variations exist, but when you get a good smoky-fruity balance, nothing else compares.

name: Black Opium
description: A highly addictive feminine fragrance from Yves Saint Laurent. Fascinating and seductively intoxicating, the opening notes of adrenaline-rich coffee and the sweet sensuality of vanilla recline into the softness of white flowers.
description_en: A highly addictive feminine fragrance from Yves Saint Laurent. Fascinating and seductively intoxicating, the opening notes of adrenaline-rich coffee and the sweet sensuality of vanilla recline into the softness of white flowers.
description_tr: Yves Saint Laurent'dan bağımlılık yaratan kadınsı bir koku. Büyüleyici ve baştan çıkarıcı derecede sarhoş edici; adrenalin yüklü kahvenin açılış notaları ile vanilyanın tatlı şehveti, beyaz çiçeklerin yumuşaklığına teslim oluyor.

reviews.comment: The perfect blend of coffee and vanilla. It feels dark, mysterious, and warm. My go-to night out fragrance.
Sweet, warm, and highly seductive. The coffee note could be stronger, but the vanilla-pear combination is gorgeous.

name: Shalimar
description: Inspired by the passionate love story between an emperor and an Indian princess, Shalimar, which means 'temple of love' in Sanskrit, symbolizes the promise of eternal love forever. It is a fragrance of desire.
description_en: Inspired by the passionate love story between an emperor and an Indian princess, Shalimar, which means 'temple of love' in Sanskrit, symbolizes the promise of eternal love forever. It is a fragrance of desire.
description_tr: Bir imparator ile Hint prensesi arasındaki tutkulu aşk hikayesinden ilham alan ve Sanskritçe'de 'aşk tapınağı' anlamına gelen Shalimar, sonsuz aşk vaadini simgeliyor. Bu koku arzunun vücut bulmuş halidir.

reviews.comment: The mother of all oriental fragrances. Powdery iris, smoky incense, and rich, dark vanilla. Pure vintage royalty.
A complex, powdery masterpiece. It starts off bright and citrusy but transforms into a beautiful leather-vanilla blanket.

name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet
description: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet is a fresh and sparkling composition fashioned like a dress embroidered with flowers. The olfactory bouquet pays homage to Christian Dior's legendary love of flowers.
description_en: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet is a fresh and sparkling composition fashioned like a dress embroidered with flowers. The olfactory bouquet pays homage to Christian Dior's legendary love of flowers.
description_tr: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet, çiçeklerle süslenmiş bir elbise gibi tasarlanmış, taze ve ışıltılı bir kompozisyondur. Bu koku buketi, Christian Dior'un efsanevi çiçek sevgisine bir saygı duruşu niteliğindedir.

reviews.comment: The most beautiful, delicate floral scent ever created. It smells like a fresh spring morning in a flower market.
Extremely elegant and airy. Sillage is light, but it is the perfect office or warm-weather fragrance.

name: Black XS
description: Black XS is a dark, sweet, and woody fragrance with an outlaw attitude. A fragrance that combines fresh lemon and kalamanzi notes with sweet praline, spiced black cardamom, and deep, dark patchouli.
description_en: Black XS is a dark, sweet, and woody fragrance with an outlaw attitude. A fragrance that combines fresh lemon and kalamanzi notes with sweet praline, spiced black cardamom, and deep, dark patchouli.
description_tr: Black XS, asi bir tavra sahip, karanlık, tatlı ve odunsu bir kokudur. Taze limon ve kalamanzi notalarını; tatlı pralin, baharatlı siyah kakule ve derin, karanlık paçuli ile harmanlayan bir kompozisyon.

reviews.comment: Love the sweet strawberry-like vibe created by the lemon and praline. It's got a very unique, edgy vibe.
Dark, sweet, and rebellious. It's got a heavy praline sweetness balanced by woody base notes. Great for cooler weather.

name: Ganymede
description: A new, elegant, and unexpected mineral-leather fragrance. Ganymede plays on the contrast of brightness and depth, combining suede leather notes with violet, mandarin orange, and mineral-salty immortelle.
description_en: A new, elegant, and unexpected mineral-leather fragrance. Ganymede plays on the contrast of brightness and depth, combining suede leather notes with violet, mandarin orange, and mineral-salty immortelle.
description_tr: Yeni, zarif ve beklenmedik bir mineral-deri kokusu. Aydınlık ve derinlik arasındaki tezatla oynayan Ganymede; süet deri notalarını menekşe, mandalina ve mineral-tuzlu ölmezçiçek ile birleştiriyor.

reviews.comment: This smells like a luxury spacecraft or a clean, metallic leather handbag. Mind-blowingly unique and futuristic.
An absolute masterpiece by Quentin Bisch. Mineral, salty, leathery, and incredibly clean all at once. Lasts forever.
